outcome: Temporal changes in specific taxa abundance (e.g., Escherichia-Shigella, Enterococcus, Pluralibacter, Taonella, Patulibacter)
cohort: The study included 30 preterm infants hospitalized during the initial four weeks of life.
finding: Delivery mode influences the composition and function of the preterm infant gut microbiota, with these effects being time-dependent during the early stages of life.
mod_finding: Delivery mode significantly impacts the composition and function of the preterm infant gut microbiota, with observed differences in specific taxa related to vaginal or cesarean delivery that fluctuate over the first four weeks of life.
